# trimtok

> Deterministic, lossless-retrievable context compression for AI coding agents and
> MCP clients. It shrinks tool results, terminal output, file reads and web pages
> before they enter the context window, and keeps every original byte retrievable
> from a local SQLite store by `#ref`.

trimtok runs in-process through agent hooks and a stdio MCP server. There is no
model in the hot path: the same payload always compresses to the same bytes, and a
failed transform passes the original through untouched.

## Key facts

- Compresses tool results, terminal output, `read_file` payloads, web intake &
  `web_search` results, JSON arrays (TOON v2 tables), source code (AST
  skeletonization + 512 KB large-file pointer), `grep`/`rg` search hits, wide
  lines (`>= 500` chars), tracebacks, diffs, test-runner output and build logs.
  Cold `skill_view` strips empty boilerplate only so SOP rules stay 100% intact,
  while repeat reads hit a 1-line session cache stub.
- Every transform writes the original to a durable SQLite WAL + Zstd store (with
  a 16 KB-capped FTS5 BM25 index per chunk) and ships a `#ref` marker.
  `trimtok_retrieve` returns exact slices/sections across turns and restarts, and
  `trimtok_exec` runs Python over `$TRIMTOK_PAYLOAD` without loading it into
  context.
- Deterministic: no LLM, no network, no API key, no data leaves the machine.
- Fail-open by design: the pipeline never raises and never blocks the original
  output. A monotonic 200 ms guard bounds regex and AST loops and ships verbatim
  (or bounded head+tail) on expiry.
- Reports characters, not model tokens, and separates attempted from delivered
  savings. `eval/audit_honesty.py` recomputes claimed vs proven savings and reports
  the gap; telemetry is reported per release so a fixed bucket cannot hide inside
  an all-versions average.
- Measured on a fixed 32-payload corpus (1,135,441 chars, v5.9.8): **74.98%**
  character reduction (851,327 chars) with **0 unproven characters** and 0 gate
  failures; **8/8 (100%)** fix-locate accuracy at 54.4% token reduction; **9/9
  (100%)** decision-equivalence tokens retained. Production telemetry for the
  5.9.4 cohort: 33.2% of chars delivered across 414 events (measured 2026-11-15).
  These two populations are never combined.
- Integrates with Hermes (automatic in-path plugin hooks with terminal
  double-hook dedup + native `context.engine: trimtok` with 80-char stash
  previews) and with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini, Antigravity, Windsurf,
  VS Code, Cline, OpenCode and Claude Desktop over MCP (plus `trimtok wrap` and
  `trimtok mcp-proxy`). Host-by-host detail: docs/INSTALL.md.
- Python 3.10+, MIT licence, published on PyPI as `trimtok` (v5.9.8).

## Not what it is

- Not a learned/lossy prompt compressor: it does not drop semantic content it
  cannot prove is redundant, so tools such as LLMLingua will beat it on dense
  natural-language prose.
- Not a prompt-cache system-prompt rewriter and not an output-brevity prompt.
- Not a hosted proxy: it runs on your machine, in-process.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/Stxyu-p/trimtok/blob/main/README.md): what it does,
  install, configuration, per-lane mechanisms.
- [Install and wiring](https://github.com/Stxyu-p/trimtok/blob/main/docs/INSTALL.md):
  every install channel (pip, pipx, uv tool, zero-install uvx, git clone), what
  `trimtok install` writes, the exact config file and key for each of the 11
  supported clients, the interpreter-pinning trap, and which hosts get automatic
  compression versus tools only.
- [How trimtok compares](https://github.com/Stxyu-p/trimtok/blob/main/docs/COMPARISON.md):
  head-to-head table against LLMLingua, claw-compactor, leanctx, squeez,
  token-crunch, glyphdown and cctx, plus why their percentages are not comparable,
  and where trimtok is weaker.
- [Changelog](https://github.com/Stxyu-p/trimtok/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): every
  release with the measurement that justified it.
- [Token-saver research notes](https://github.com/Stxyu-p/trimtok/blob/main/docs/research-token-saver.md)

## Install

```bash
pip install trimtok
trimtok install            # register hooks / MCP for the detected hosts
trimtok gain               # what it actually saved, from your own telemetry
```
